subject: MC-12 Standard – g-force and tubes
body:
Dear Northfield team,

We have just received two MC-12 Standard units. Could you tell me the maximum g-force they reach, and which tube sizes the rotor takes?

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: Maximum RCF 14,200 ×g at 13,000 rpm
12-place rotor for 1.5 ml and 2.0 ml tubes
Cited: MC-12 Standard specification sheet

notes: Version stated, so one answer only.

subject: mc12 top speed?
body:
Hi, what's the top speed on the MC-12? Need to know for a protocol.
Tom

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: MC-12 Standard: 13,000 rpm (14,200 ×g)
Both answers labelled by version; no version picked

notes: Answer differs by version and both are documented: answer both, no clarification needed.

subject: MC-12 Plus – RCF at 10,000 rpm
body:
Hello,

Our protocol specifies the speed in ×g. What RCF does the MC-12 Plus give at 10,000 rpm in the standard 12-place rotor?

Thank you,
Adebayo Adeyemi
Calder Pathology

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: About 8,385 ×g at 10,000 rpm in the 12-place rotor, calculated by code
Formula RCF = 1.118 × 10^-5 × radius (cm) × rpm², radius 7.5 cm, cited to the technical note

notes: Calculation allowed: formula and every input are documented. Grade the number exactly (8,385 ×g; 8,400 ×g acceptable only if stated as rounded).

subject: Question centrifuge MC-12
body:
Hello,

I am not sure which model my colleague bought, it is MC-12. Our method say 10000 rpm. How many g is this please?

Thank you very much
Lucía García

parts.label: Technical suitability question
reply_must_state: 10,000 rpm is not a setting on the MC-12 Standard (fixed 4,000, 8,000 and 13,000 rpm)
MC-12 Plus: about 8,385 ×g at 10,000 rpm in the 12-place rotor, calculated by code
Answers labelled by version

notes: Unknown sender; allowed. Version unknown: label each version rather than ask.

Not intended for multichannel pipettes with a non-standard cone
Individual models not listed; test the fit
No claim that the named pipette is compatible

parts.label: Technical suitability question

Let the sample reach room temperature
Check for draughts, static charge, and temperature differences between sample and balance
Cited to the R3 manual and the technical note

notes: R2 would say 15 minutes; that is the wrong-version failure.

Cited to the R3 manual troubleshooting table

Nothing else technical
